sourceChecks.rationale: The public Kotlin model/enum/action types and Composable signature match the contract. Production imports use existing Compose/Foundation/Material APIs. Each final source-bound native test command completed with exit code 0; no new dependency declaration is introduced in the sealed production archive.

Effective selection and all branches derive directly from current immutable model properties; no remembered competing selection or consent state. Native caller-update evidence is separately graded per case.

Production declares whole-row selectable radio semantics, Checkbox/toggleable consent and native buttons with unique meaningful IDs and minimum 48dp targets. Native exposure and observed target dimensions are separately graded.
Text expands and wraps with scaled sp typography; no ellipsis/line limit, shrink-to-fit or fixed text height is declared. Actual narrow/large-text screenshots are separately graded.
Intrinsic non-lazy Column, no nested scroll or fixed panel height; actual parent scrolling is separately graded.

Semantic layout follows LayoutDirection and supplied light/dark palette. TextDirection.ContentOrLtr preserves numeric-only ranges under RTL; actual RTL ranges and mirrored controls are separately checked in initial_05 and repair_holdout_02.
